tasks.gr7-personal-social-wellbeing-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering goal setting, exam stress, community responsibility, healthy routines, and future planning. Ask scenario questions about balancing wellbeing with study demands and making realistic plans.
tasks.gr7-physical-education-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering personal fitness plans, game strategy, participation review, and recreation. Ask learners to apply strategy in game contexts and evaluate their year-long physical development.
tasks.gr7-creative-arts-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering portfolio curation, rehearsal discipline, integrated showcase preparation, and self-evaluation. Ask learners to choose evidence-based improvement steps and audience-focused presentation decisions.
